73071-in-korea-with-marquis-ito.title: A Critical And Historical Inquiry
73071-in-korea-with-marquis-ito.creator: George Trumbull Ladd, Ll.D.
73071-in-korea-with-marquis-ito.description: A book by George Trumbull Ladd, Ll.D.. It was in early August of 1906 that I left New Haven for a third visit to Japan. Travelling by the way of the Great Lakes through Duluth and St. Paul, after a stay of two weeks in Seattle, we took the Japanese ship _Aki Maru_ for Yokohama, where we arrived just before the port was closed for the night of September 20.

77680-yiddish-short-stories.creator: Unknown

It never dreamt to behold such a distinction between the “Good” and the “Evil.” “There” it had often recognized neither of them and had mistaken the one for the other.

arxiv-2012-06151.title: Dijet Acoplanarity in CUJET3 as a Probe of the Nonperturbative Color Structure of QCD Perfect Fluids
arxiv-2012-06151.creator: M. Gyulassy, P.M. Jacobs, J. Liao, S. Shi, X.N. Wang, F. Yuan
arxiv-2012-06151.description: Abstract Using the CUJET3=DGLV+VISHNU jet-medium interaction framework, we show that dijet azimuthal acoplanarity in high energy A + A A+A collisions is sensitive to possible non-perturbative enhancement of the jet transport coefficient, q ^ ​ ( T , E ) \hat{q}(T,E) , in the QCD crossover temperature T ∼ 150 − 300 T\sim 150-300 MeV range.

arxiv-2104-04012.title: Path-Connectedness in Global Bifurcation Theory
arxiv-2104-04012.creator: J. F. Toland
arxiv-2104-04012.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by J. F. Toland. A celebrated result in bifurcation theory is that global connected sets of non-trivial solutions bifurcate from trivial solutions at non-zero eigenvalues of odd algebraic multiplicity of the linearized problem when the operators involved are compact. In this paper a simple example is constructed which satisfies the regularity hypotheses of the global bifurcation theorem, and the eigenvalue has algebraic multiplicity one, yet all the path-connected components of the connected sets that bifurcate are singletons.

arxiv-2105-14113.title: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Stability of Discrete-Time Switched Linear Systems with Ranged Dwell Time
arxiv-2105-14113.creator: Weiming Xiang
arxiv-2105-14113.description: Abstract This paper deals with the stability analysis problem of discrete-time switched linear systems with ranged dwell time. A novel concept called 𝑳 L -switching-cycle is proposed, which contains sequences of multiple activation cycles satisfying the prescribed ranged dwell time constraint.

arxiv-2303-08123.title: Identifying Promising Candidate Radiotherapy Protocols via GPU-GA in-silico
arxiv-2303-08123.creator: Wojciech Ozimek, Rafał Banaś, Paweł Gora, Simon D. Angus, Monika J. Piotrowska
arxiv-2303-08123.description: Abstract Around half of all cancer patients, world-wide, will receive some form of radiotherapy (RT) as part of their treatment. And yet, despite the rapid advance of high-throughput screening to identify successful chemotherapy drug candidates, there is no current analogue for RT protocol screening or discovery at any scale.

arxiv-2304-05080.title: Investigating Imbalances Between SAR and Optical Utilization for Multi-Modal Urban Mapping Thanks: This work was supported by the Swedish National Space Agency under Grant dnr 155/15; Digital Futures under the grant for the EO-AI4GlobalChange Project; the ESA-China Dragon 5 Program under the EO-AI4U
arxiv-2304-05080.creator: Sebastian Hafner, Yifang Ban, Andrea Nascetti
arxiv-2304-05080.description: Abstract Accurate urban maps provide essential information to support sustainable urban development. Recent urban mapping methods use multi-modal deep neural networks to fuse Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and optical data. However, multi-modal networks may rely on just one modality due to the greedy nature of learning.

arxiv-2306-04643.title: Abnormal Trading Detection in the NFT Market
arxiv-2306-04643.creator: Mingxiao Song, Yunsong Liu, Agam Shah, Sudheer Chava
arxiv-2306-04643.description: Abstract . The Non-Fungible-Token (NFT) market has experienced explosive growth in recent years. According to DappRadar, the total transaction volume on OpenSea, the largest NFT marketplace, reached 34.7 billion dollars in February 2023. However, the NFT market is mostly unregulated and there are significant concerns about money laundering, fraud and wash trading.

arxiv-2409-17975.title: Simulation-based inference benchmark for weak lensing cosmology
arxiv-2409-17975.creator: Justine Zeghal, Denise Lanzieri, François Lanusse, Alexandre Boucaud, Gilles Louppe, Eric Aubourg, Adrian E. Bayer, The LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
arxiv-2409-17975.description: Abstract Context. Standard cosmological analysis, which is based on two-point statistics, fails to extract all the information embedded in the cosmological data. This limits our ability to precisely constrain cosmological parameters. Through willingness to use modern analysis techniques to match the power of upcoming telescopes, recent years have seen a paradigm shift from analytical likelihood-based to simulation-based inference.

arxiv-2505-09375.title: Strategies to Measure Energy Consumption Using RAPL During Workflow Execution on Commodity Clusters
arxiv-2505-09375.creator: Philipp Thamm, Ulf Leser
arxiv-2505-09375.description: Abstract In science, problems in many fields can be solved by processing datasets using a series of computationally expensive algorithms, sometimes referred to as workflows. Traditionally, the configurations of these workflows are optimized to achieve a short runtime for the given task and dataset on a given (often distributed) infrastructure.

arxiv-2505-16313.creator: Arjhun Swaminathan 1 2 3, Mete Akgün 2 3
arxiv-2505-16313.description: Abstract Deep neural networks for image classification remain vulnerable to adversarial examples — small, imperceptible perturbations that induce misclassifications. In black-box settings, where only the final prediction is accessible, crafting targeted attacks that aim to misclassify into a specific target class is particularly challenging due to narrow decision regions.

arxiv-2508-07963.title: Runtime Verification for LTL in Stochastic Systems
arxiv-2508-07963.creator: Javier Esparza, Vincent Fischer
arxiv-2508-07963.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Javier Esparza, Vincent Fischer. Runtime verification encompasses several lightweight techniques for checking whether a system’s current execution satisfies a given specification. We focus on runtime verification for Linear Temporal Logic (LTL). Previous work describes monitors which produce, at every time step one of three outputs - true, false, or inconclusive - depending on whether the observed execution prefix definitively determines satisfaction of the formula. However, for many LTL formulas, such as liveness properties, satisfaction cannot be concluded from any finite prefix.

pmc-10499248.title: An improved multi-scale branching convolutional neural network for rolling bearing fault diagnosis
pmc-10499248.creator: Meng Xu, Yaowei Shi, Minqiang Deng, Yang Liu, Xue Ding, Aidong Deng
pmc-10499248.description: The vibration signals measured in practical engineering are usually complex and noisy, which brings challenges to fault diagnosis. In addition, industrial scenarios also put forward higher requirements for the accuracy and computational efficiency of diagnostic models. Aiming at these problems, an improved multiscale branching convolutional neural network is proposed for rolling bearing fault diagnosis.

pmc-11404452.title: Study of the RNA splicing kinetics via in vivo 5-EU labeling
pmc-11404452.creator: Anastasiia K. Bolikhova, Andrey I. Buyan, Sofia S. Mariasina, Alexander Y. Rudenko, Daria S. Chekh, Alexander M. Mazur, Egor B. Prokhortchouk, Olga A. Dontsova, Petr V. Sergiev
pmc-11404452.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Splicing is an important step of gene expression in all eukaryotes. Splice sites might be used with different efficiency, giving rise to alternative splicing products. At the same time, splice sites might be used at a variable rate. We used 5-ethynyl uridine labeling to sequence a nascent transcriptome of HeLa cells and deduced the rate of splicing for each donor and acceptor splice site. The following correlation analysis showed a correspondence of primary transcript features with the rate of splicing.

pmc-12474016.title: Agreement Document for the Study of Leishmaniasis from a One Health Approach in Spain
pmc-12474016.creator: Joaquina Martín-Sánchez, Jose M Requena, Montserrat Gállego, Maribel Jiménez, Ricardo Molina, Paul Nguewa, Francisco Morillas-Márquez, José M Pérez-Victoria, Begoña Monge-Maillo, Manuel Morales-Yuste, Clotilde Marín, Jean-Paul Gonzalez
pmc-12474016.description: Background: Leishmaniasis, a vector-borne disease caused by the parasite Leishmania, is a public health concern in Europe. Although Spain is an endemic country, it lacks a national surveillance network. To address this, the creation of a research and surveillance network is proposed, which would integrate data from various fields and enhance control and public health strategies.

pmc-12604112.title: Regaining independence: a grounded theory study of the process of rehabilitation changes in patients with hemiplegic stroke
pmc-12604112.creator: Huaqing Liu, Zhe Li, Shiyou Fu, Zhengjia Ren
pmc-12604112.description: BackgroundResearch focusing on the rehabilitation experiences of stroke patients in China remains limited. Understanding their recovery journey is essential for improving care strategies and enhancing patients’ well-being. This study aimed to explore the psychosocial mechanisms and processes underlying the rehabilitation of hemiplegic stroke patients.

pmc-12709758.title: Frailty progression before and after diabetes onset among older adults in china: a nationwide cohort study
pmc-12709758.creator: Ruomei Yang, Fang Sun, Zongming Yang, Zhencheng Yan, Zhigang Zhao, Hongbo He, Zhiming Zhu
pmc-12709758.description: BackgroundAlthough epidemiological studies have established a link between diabetes and frailty, the dynamic changes in frailty before and after diabetes diagnosis remained inadequately characterized. This study aimed to examine the trajectories of frailty preceding and following diabetes diagnosis in older adults and to identify potential modifiers of the association between diabetes and trajectories of frailty.

pmc-12731818.title: A Specific Haplotype of the MMP2 Gene Promoter May Increase the Risk of Developing Cerebral Palsy
pmc-12731818.creator: Ana Djuranovic Uklein, Natasa Cerovac, Dijana Perovic, Nela Maksimovic, Biljana Jekic, Milka Grk, Marija Dusanovic Pjevic, Milica Rasic, Natasa Stojanovski, Milica Pesic, Ivana Novakovic, Tatjana Damnjanovic
pmc-12731818.description: Background/Objectives: Hypoxic–ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) is a common neurological outcome of perinatal asphyxia, with cerebral palsy (CP) being the most severe lasting effect. Perinatal brain injury activates the immune system and induces the release of inflammatory mediators. Matrix Metalloproteinases (MMPs) play a crucial role in neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.

pmc-13493281.title: Perioperative and mid-term outcomes of endovascular aortic repair in patients with moderate-to-advanced chronic kidney disease: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13493281.creator: Yangyang Xia, Chun Ouyang, Xiaoqiang Ye, Mingming Ren, Guang Yang, Lei Huang
pmc-13493281.description: BackgroundAortic lesions and chronic kidney disease (CKD) frequently coexist, increasing perioperative risks. While endovascular aortic repair (EVAR/TEVAR) offers a less invasive alternative, its safety profile in moderate-to-advanced CKD remains unclear. This study evaluated clinical outcomes and prognostic factors in this high-risk population.
